读取类：读取应用状态、终端缓冲区、日志、审计记录。永远允许（敏感字段仍受「允许读: Read application state, terminal buffers, logs and audit records. Always allowed; sensitive fields still require permission.

界面写入：修改 CSS / 设计令牌 / 前端 store / 合成 DOM 事: Change CSS, design tokens, frontend stores and DOM events to verify UI changes. May misrepresent interface state. Disabled by default; no token required.
配置写入：修改服务器、隧道与应用设置（含调试设置本身）。风险：可持久化错误配置，: Modify servers, tunnels and application settings, including debug settings. May persist incorrect configuration. Disabled by default; setting changes require two-step confirmation.

凭据写入：新增 / 修改 / 删除保存的凭据。需同时开启「允许读取敏感数据」与两: Add, modify or delete saved credentials. Requires sensitive data access and two-step confirmation.
远端文件写入：SFTP 写入 / 删除 / 改名 / 建目录 / 上传。仅白名单: Write, delete, rename, create and upload remote files through SFTP. Only paths in SFTPWriteAllowlist are allowed; an empty list blocks all writes. Writes / deletes require two-step confirmation.
sudo 凭证提权：允许 AI 在当前会话对应的服务器上，用应用里保存的密码执行: Allow AI to run sudo -i on the current saved server using its stored password, granting root access. Requires secrets.read because the password comes from the credential vault. Passwords never appear in MCP parameters, results, logs or audit records; callers cannot provide a password. The password is written only to a random remote temporary file (/tmp/.ding-sudo-<12 hex digits>, mode 600), deleted and verified after use. The temporary path must also match the remote write allowlist; without /tmp access this is rejected. Unsupported for local terminals or servers without a saved password. Very high risk, disabled by default. Enabling and each terminal.sudo execution require confirmation.
